translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: 2 Timoteo
book.title: Kart wchopi daa bzej Páblona' na' bseḻeen lao Timotewa'

content: Ḻekzka' chiyaḻ' iṉezilo' dga: kat' ba zoa te c̱he yell-lioni, dii zan dii nxoll gat'.

Ḻa' beṉ' zan c̱he to kwinzgake' segake' wṉeyi, na' lillinzi selall'gake' gat' kwe'gakile' mech, na' gakgake' beṉ' llalj na' beṉ' chep cha'lall'. Biz gon iṉagake' c̱he Chioza', na' bi wzoagake' xtill' x̱axṉeeka', ni bi we'gake' yeḻ' chox̱ken beṉ' gaklen ḻegake', na' ni bi yoo yic̱hjgake' gongake' ka cheeni Chioza'.

Na' bi yiyesh'lall'gakile' beṉ', ni bi si'xen c̱he bish' ljwellgake', na' ḻe c̱hilj sangake' dill' c̱he beṉ'. Na' bi sakgakile' iṉabia' kwingake', na' ḻe yibagakile' wc̱hi' wsak'gake' beṉ', na' gakzbangakile' yog'ḻoḻte daa nak wen.
Gakgake' beṉ' c̱hop cho'a dill', na' beṉ' bibi nalli, na' gon kwingake' beṉ' choo beṉ' xen. Na' ḻe yibachgakile' gongake' kon ka chzelall'gake' latjin dii nan gongake' ka cheeni Chioza'.
Ḻa'kzi gonzgake' ka beṉ' ḻe nx̱enilall' Chios, na' to kwinzgake' wli' wze c̱hegake' nan biṉ' we'gake' latj wshaa Chioza' yic̱hjlall'do'eka'. Na' li' ṉaa, bi chiyaḻ' gono' ni to beṉ'ki txen.
Ḻa' kan' nak beṉ' wxiye'ka' chda to to yoo, na' chziye'gake' noolka' bi nteyi, beṉ'ka' lall' lao saaxyana' na' chongake' biya dii mal.
Noolki tlizi chzenaggake' daa chli' chsedi nottezə beṉ' ḻegake' na' biga llia chombia'gake' daa nak dii ḻi.

Ka ben beṉ'ka' le Janes na'ch Jambres, wzoshyi'gake' dii Moiséza', kan' chon beṉ'ki chsej chllongake' c̱heyi daa nak dii ḻi daa nxiṉj nḻen yic̱hjlall'do'eka'. Na' bi nde beṉ'ki kwent lao Chioza' ḻa'kzi nazgake' noṉlilall'gake'ne'.
Na' aga wgol daa chongake', ḻa' yog' beṉ' gakbe'i nakgake' beṉ' bi yejni'alallii, ka gok c̱he beṉ'ka' c̱hop, beṉ'ka' wzoshyi' dii Moiséza'.

Na' li', ṉaa lla, ba ṉezkzilo' ka nak daa chli' chsedid', ka nsa' c̱ha', ka nak daa llialallaa gon', ka nonḻilallaa Chioza', na' ka nak yeḻ' chxenlallaa na' yeḻ' chakina' nap', na' ka chtip lallaa kwenc̱he chzo chzakid' yeḻ' zak'zi'ki chtiḻ'.
Na' ṉezilo' ka nak yeḻ' zak'zi'ka' diika' ba bllagloa', ka diika' btiḻ' Antioquíana', na' Icóniona', na'ch Lístrana'. Ḻa'kzi dii zan dii ba bllagloa', X̱anchona' ba bisle' nad' lao yog'ḻoḻten.
Dii ḻi, yog'ḻoḻ beṉ'ka' cheengakile' gongake' ka cheeni Chioza' daa nakgake' txen Cristo Jesúza', wsak'zi' beṉ' ḻegake'.
Na' beṉ' wen dii malka' len beṉ' wxiye'ka', zizikli gongake' mal, na' gakleləgakile' siye'chgake' beṉ' na' ax̱t kwingake' ba chiyajḻe'gake' c̱he yeḻ' wxiye' c̱he'ka'.
Na' li', ṉaa, wzoac̱hec̱h lawi daa ba nsedo' na' ba wyajḻi'o. Ḻa' nombia'kzo' beṉ'ka' bli' bsedi li'.
Jadini kana' naktio' bi'do' nombi'o Cho'a Xtill' Chioza', na' ḻennan' goṉan li' yeḻ' sin'na' daa chsedin li' gonḻilalloo Cristo Jesúza' kwenc̱he yilo' na' bi kwiayoo.

Kwin Chioza' bzajniile' dii beṉ'ka' bzej doxen Cho'a Xtilleena', na' zakaan wli' wsedin beṉ', wsheshlenan beṉ' bi chon wen, yigoon shḻi lall' beṉ' naklleji, na' wzajniin beṉ' kwenc̱he gake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao',
kwenc̱he beena' chon ka cheeni Chioza' zizikli gakchache' na' gak gone' yog' diika' nak wen.
